answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making reputation a mirror of earned work rather than a claim anyone can mint. A newcomer starts on bare terrace: nothing is granted, so it must contribute checkable labor and collect countersignatures from established peers before its vote carries weight. Influence accumulates like nectar gathered flower by flower, while a swarm of freshly created keys brings no history to trade. Because weight follows witnessed tenure and not account count, a farm that spawns a thousand identities ends with a thousand silent shells.
